loss: MSE after division by training-only global channel standard deviation
selection: mean of count and energy validation MAE relative to fixed training-hour-of-week mean baseline; per-seed checkpoint and one ridge alpha; no test tuning
normalization: New model-specific raw-value scaler fitted to completed-before-training-cutoff event aggregates; fixed for validation/test. Original dataset log scaler unchanged.
test_gate: Write and hash FINAL_SELECTION.json with all checkpoints before loading test windows; score all frozen models once, no retraining on validation
scope: 112 training-selected core Hangzhou grid regions; fulfilled observed order starts and eventual session kWh attributed to start hour; not power load, not AgentMove reproduction
prior_exposure: January aggregate outcomes were seen under earlier individual-station protocols. This is not a pristine blind dataset.
